message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: For each object, CRM → Contacts (then Companies, Deals, Tickets, Calls, each custom object) → open the All [records] view → Export → pick CSV or XLSX → Include all properties → Export. Repeat per object; each one lands as an emailed download link that expires after 30 days, capped at 1 million records per export.
- **We pull it**, Instructions: From a Super Admin account, Settings (gear icon) → Integrations → Private Apps (now labeled Legacy Apps in some portals) → Create a private app → Scopes tab → tick every read scope (CRM objects, files, automation, marketing email, forms) → Create app → Auth tab → Show token → Copy. Send us that access token over secure means.

Let me know if you would prefer to push this data to us or have us pull it for you!
notes: The verified precedent proves contacts, not a whole-account export.
